title: DATA ADVISOR: Dynamic Data Curation for Safety Alignment of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting fine-tuned models with stereotype-related harmful questions from the CatQA and BeaverTails datasets and measuring the harmful response rate using the LlamaGuard automatic evaluator.
Prompting fine-tuned models with discrimination-related queries from the BeaverTails dataset and measuring the ratio of unsafe responses using LlamaGuard.
Evaluating the ratio of unsafe responses to hate speech, violence, and harassment prompts from the BeaverTails and CatQA datasets using LlamaGuard.

Qualitative evaluation of the system's ability to iteratively identify and generate prompts targeting specific underrepresented demographic and identity harms, such as algorithmic discrimination in hiring, transgender identity incongruence, and threats to linguistic diversity.
